skill_card.name: Evaluator Skill
skill_card.description: Audits agent skills on quality (best practices, progressive disclosure, functional lift, trigger F1) and security (NVIDIA SkillSpector 17-category vulnerability taxonomy), producing scored Markdown & JSON reports.

tasks.name: Validate Spec 1.0 Schema Compliance
tasks.description: Checks frontmatter YAML syntax, regex rules, path containment, and line count budgets.

tasks.name: Run NVIDIA SkillSpector AST Security Audit
tasks.description: Scans across 17 vulnerability categories and Python AST for prompt injection, data leaks, and dangerous execution.
tasks.input_schema: Skill directory and baseline suppression configuration.
tasks.output_schema: Security findings list and pass/block gate decision.

tasks.name: Evaluate Functional Correctness & Lift
tasks.description: Grades assertion passes in evals/evals.json and computes lift delta against baseline agent performance.
tasks.output_schema: Functional accuracy score, lift delta, and execution trace.
